config.entry: Observed actual session open; assumes immediate fill after probability evaluation
config.input: 30 completed OHLCV bars plus today's candidate entry price
config.both_touch: stop first for intraday ambiguous touches; known opening gap evaluated first
config.default_primary_exit: carry until barrier; eod timeout reported separately
config.selected_model: Previously locked 2024 winner; no reselection using backtest
config.cost: Hypothetical symmetric entry/exit friction; not Kiwoom actual fee/tax schedule
config.capital: No leverage/shorting; whole shares; max20 by default; 5%startdayequity perposition
config.sampling: ALL approved 2025+ samples from frozen training-availability universe; no60kcap
config.missing_price: Freeze last mark and cash; uncertain path; exit on next observed open, not retroactively
config.limitation: Daily OHLC research simulation; no bid/ask/latency/auction queue/price-limit fill modeling

assumptions: Actual OPEN entries; signal > 0.5; both touches STOP FIRST
Opening gaps execute at OPEN; intraday exits never finance OPEN entries
One entry per symbol/day; integer shares; long only; no leverage
Liquidity cap uses supplied past-only share volume
Roundtrip bps split equally across actual entry/exit notionals
No bid/ask spread, market impact, partial fills, or price-limit restrictions
Missing held prices lock capital and use stale marks; resume at next observed OPEN
Missing-price paths and terminal stale-price liquidation are uncertain accounting, not observed execution
Last session forced CLOSE exit is an evaluation convention
